text.aria-label: Title text 'Figure 6: The clear-sky index keeps the solar day's shape, where linear interpolation shifts it late'
text.tspan: Figure 6: The clear-sky index keeps the solar day's shape, where linear

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Top of each pair: the ensemble mean of one day at one generator, upsampled to hourly each way; squares mark ENS's own steps, each radiation value the mean over the step ending at the square. Bottom: that generator's measured hourly output. The same calendar day at day 1 and day 7. Days chosen by rule from measured output alone: for solar the April-to-September day with the largest mean hour-to- hour change, for wind the day with the largest range. Generator not named. Capacity is each generator's 99th-percentile output.'
text.tspan: Top of each pair: the ensemble mean of one day at one generator, upsampled to hourly each way; squares mark ENS's
own steps, each radiation value the mean over the step ending at the square. Bottom: that generator's measured
hourly output. The same calendar day at day 1 and day 7.
Days chosen by rule from measured output alone: for solar the April-to-September day with the largest mean hour-to-
hour change, for wind the day with the largest range. Generator not named.
